label: Isolate Voice
description: Remove background noise from a recording, keeping only the voice. Audio file in, cleaned audio file out.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The ElevenLabs access (wire an ElevenLabsAccess node).

inputs.name: fileFormat
inputs.label: Recording format
inputs.description: If the recording is raw 16-bit PCM at 16 kHz, mono, little-endian, pick pcm_s16le_16: ElevenLabs answers sooner than for an encoded file. Leave `other` for anything else.

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The voice with the background removed, stored as the type ElevenLabs answers with (its reference gives mp3), whatever type the recording was.
